title: Rhythm of War
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: The fourth Stormlight Archive novel, in which a long war has settled into a stalemate and each side races to find a technological or magical edge. It puts a lot of weight on how its main characters cope with trauma and duty.
readIf: you are already reading the series and want a heavier focus on mental health, spycraft and invention.
skipIf: you're new to the series, since the previous three books are necessary context.

pairings.reason: A big, self-contained epic with multiple viewpoints and ancient powers, if you want something that ends in one book.
Another fantasy where the world's natural forces feel enormous and characters are shaped by trauma.
Same author, more tightly paced and a good palate cleanser for his clever magic systems.
